company.shortDescription: Agentnoon designs dynamic people analytics tool in order to drive organizational performance.
company.description:
We are Agentnoon. The only workforce planning tool that saves you an average of ~7.5% on your headcount budget. Every year. 

Create org plans, manage headcount, and forecast costs all in one easy-to-use SaaS tool. Signup takes 1-click; setup takes 15 minutes (not weeks). 

Upload your spreadsheet, and you’re all set! It’s that simple.

We integrate with 100+ HRIS, Payroll, and ATS tools. This makes Agentnoon the single source of truth for all your people data. So you make fewer errors and better hiring decisions.

We love our customers. And they love us (NPS 9.5). We resolve ~80% of support queries within a day. Onboarding takes <24 hours. No more 6 month-long implementation cycles. Plus, our world-class concierge support is here when you need us.

Grow your business with confidence. Only with Agentnoon.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,943,374 to $9,960,228, a 2.01x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 71 (-6 over 90 days) and market heat at 60 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
